findings.title: Port is already in use
findings.cause: container agent exits because the port it listens on is already in use: the pod runs in the node's network (hostNetwork: true), so it shares ports with every process of the node, and 10250 is the kubelet's; its log says: "httpd: bind: Address already in use"; Deployment node-agent has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container agent exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 6 times
last lines of container agent's log (current run)
evidence.detail: httpd: bind: Address already in use

evidence.command: kubectl get pod node-agent-68f6b4788b-ljlsc -n kd-hostnetwork-port-taken -o jsonpath='{.spec.hostNetwork}'

findings.fix: Listen on a port nothing on the node uses, or drop hostNetwork and reach the pod through a Service (or a hostPort, which the scheduler checks against the other pods' host ports).
